sourceTitle: You can now generate, preview, and edit documents, PDFs, presentations, spreadsheets, and more directly in Gemini.
originalTitle: You can now generate, preview, and edit documents, PDFs, presentations, spreadsheets, and more directly in Gemini.

blocks.text: We’re introducing new ways to create and refine documents, PDFs, presentations, spreadsheets, code, and more in the Gemini app.
blocks.zh: 我们正在推出新的方法来创建和完善文件,个人防护装置,专题介绍,电子表格,代码,更多在Gemini应用程序。
blocks.en: We’re introducing new ways to create and refine documents, PDFs, presentations, spreadsheets, code, and more in the Gemini app.

blocks.text: You can now generate, preview, and edit files right within your chat — expand to full screen to type edits directly, highlight text to ask questions, or have Gemini refine your files. PDF preview and editing is supported on both the web and mobile, while all other formats (Google Docs, Google Sheets, slide decks, Markdown files, TXT files, and code) are supported on the web only.
blocks.zh: 你现在可以生成了预览,和在聊天中右侧编辑文件——扩展为全屏直接输入编辑,突出显示要提问的文本,或者让Gemini完善你的档案PDF预览和编辑在网络和移动上都得到支持,而所有其他格式(Google Docs,谷歌页,滑动甲板,标记文件,TXT文件, (中文(简体) ).和代码)只支持在网络上。
blocks.en: You can now generate, preview, and edit files right within your chat — expand to full screen to type edits directly, highlight text to ask questions, or have Gemini refine your files. PDF preview and editing is supported on both the web and mobile, while all other formats (Google Docs, Google Sheets, slide decks, Markdown files, TXT files, and code) are supported on the web only.

blocks.text: As shown in the video below, you can now ask Gemini to create a PDF study guide from your uploaded handwritten lecture notes and then you can easily manually edit, highlight specific sections to have Gemini make edits to text or visuals, and even ask further questions.
blocks.zh: 如以下影片所示,你现在可以要求Gemini从您上传的手写语录中创建 PDF 学习指南,然后可以轻松地手动编辑,强调有Gemini编辑到文本或视觉的特定部分,甚至问更多的问题。
blocks.en: As shown in the video below, you can now ask Gemini to create a PDF study guide from your uploaded handwritten lecture notes and then you can easily manually edit, highlight specific sections to have Gemini make edits to text or visuals, and even ask further questions.

blocks.text: These capabilities are now available to all users in all languages where Gemini app is available.
blocks.zh: 在有Gemini应用软件的所有语言中,现在所有用户都可以使用这些能力。
blocks.en: These capabilities are now available to all users in all languages where Gemini app is available.
